name: stat-card
title: StatCard
description: Key figure card (KPI): a small uppercase heading with an optional link, a big figure with its unit, and optional detail; StatGrid lays them out. Used on the Cockpit, Usage and test-run summaries.

a11y.pattern: named by its heading (aria-labelledby); the figure and unit are text in one
keyboard: Reaches the header link and any control in the body
aria: The grid is a named <section aria-label="Key figures">; each card is a region named by its heading
The figure is plain text, never an image; its unit follows it in the same paragraph
The figure colour (tone) is secondary: the word ("current score", "failing") carries the meaning
a11y.notes: Keep the heading level in the page outline (headingLevel). For a live figure, add a LiveIndicator in the header action slot, not a live region on the number.
